task: [.github/workflows/automation-runner.yml] `.github/workflows/automation-runner.yml` iş akışında tespit edilen 76 saniyelik darboğazı gidermek amacıyla; pip ve apt paket kurulum adımlarına `actions/cache` eklenerek bağımlılıkların her çalışmada yeniden indirilmesi önlenmeli, tetikleme mekanizmasına `paths` filtreleri eklenerek ilgisiz dosya değişikliklerinde gereksiz adımlar atlanmalı ve birbiriyle bağıntısı olmayan test adımları paralel job'lar halinde bölünerek toplam yürütme süresi optimize edilmelidir.

evidence.description: Target workflow file requiring optimization for pip/apt caching, trigger paths filtering, and test job parallelization.

factual_findings: The workflow at `.github/workflows/automation-runner.yml` contains a 76-second execution bottleneck.
Dependencies for pip and apt are downloaded repeatedly on every workflow run due to missing `actions/cache` integration.
Triggers currently lack `paths` filters, causing workflow execution even when non-impactful files are modified.
Unrelated test steps are currently executed sequentially within a single job instead of running in parallel.
hypotheses: Integrating `actions/cache` for pip and apt dependencies will eliminate redundant dependency downloads across runs.
Adding `paths` filters to event triggers will prevent workflow executions on irrelevant file commits.
Refactoring independent test steps into parallel jobs will reduce total execution time below the 76-second bottleneck.
result.recommendation: Refactor `.github/workflows/automation-runner.yml` to include `actions/cache` for pip and apt packages, add `paths` filters for push/pull_request triggers, and split sequential test steps into parallel matrix or standalone jobs.
result.next_action: Apply changes to `.github/workflows/automation-runner.yml` implementing caching, path filters, and parallel job execution.
